[[Oruba/Legends|Oruba]] [[Hutt/Legends|the Hutt]]<ref name="9th edition" /> created a '''criminal empire''' at some unknown date. It was ran by the Hutt [[Kajidii/Legends|lord]] up until his death in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].

It was mentioned that Oruba used his quick wits and self-preservation to manage and making his criminal empire going.<ref name="9th edition" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Oruba/Legends|Oruba's]] criminal empire was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine 9|9th edition]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine]]s, run by [[Titan Magazines]].
